Odile Vanterpool runs 14 beehives across two sites, restores cargo tricycles in a converted shed, and is a part-time marine biology graduate student. Mornings are for the apiary, afternoons for the workshop, Tuesday evenings for lab. See [[hive-locations-and-codes]] and [[tidepool-survey-thesis]].
